info.title: SkillLink V1 Backend API
info.description: Modular marketplace backend: authentication, verification, discovery, jobs, quotes, availability, unified booking, private messaging and voice, simulated payments, disputes, genuine reviews, notifications and audited administration. NO REAL MONEY. MongoDB replica set required for transactions.

password.description: Uppercase, lowercase and digit; at most 72 UTF-8 bytes

coordinates.description: Exactly [longitude, latitude]. Longitude -180..180; latitude -90..90, checked server-side.

WorkerProfileWrite.description: Strict professional-field allowlist. Prices use integer bututs. PUBLIC requires profession, bio >=20 characters, service and area. primaryLocation may be null. Completion, counters, owner and verification cannot be supplied.

VerificationSubmit.description: Onboarded WORKER only. IDs must reference owned uploads of their matching purpose. Resubmission is allowed only after rejection and creates a new historical record.

VerificationDecision.description: ADMIN only; only PENDING can be reviewed. REJECTED requires rejectionReason >=10 characters. workEvidenceReviewed=true requires actual submitted work evidence and APPROVED. Reviewed records cannot be edited.

amountBututs.description: Required except QUOTE_REQUIRED, where absent. 100 bututs = 1 GMD.

coordinates.description: Exactly [longitude, latitude]. Longitude -180..180; latitude -90..90, checked server-side.

PublicImage.description: Five-minute access to an eligible public image. Never verification evidence.

PublicWorker.description: No email/phone, exact coordinates, security/session fields, identity documents, references, notes or rejection reasons. Only ACTIVE WORKER + complete PUBLIC profile + active catalog references.

Verification.description: Private owning-worker DTO. Media IDs are not URLs. No private admin notes.

AdminVerification.description: Private ADMIN view with review metadata. Never public.

coordinates.description: Exactly [longitude, latitude]. Longitude -180..180; latitude -90..90, checked server-side.

JobRequestWrite.description: CUSTOMER owner only. OPEN unquoted jobs may be updated. Shared title/description may be seen by matched workers; location/privateAddress are customer-private. Expiry future <=30 days; default 7d. No client owner/status/counter/agreement fields.

coordinates.description: Exactly [longitude, latitude]. Longitude -180..180; latitude -90..90, checked server-side.

JobRequestUpdate.description: CUSTOMER owner only. OPEN unquoted jobs may be updated. Shared title/description may be seen by matched workers; location/privateAddress are customer-private. Expiry future <=30 days; default 7d. No client owner/status/counter/agreement fields.

JobBudget.description: Safe integer bututs, GMD. FIXED requires amountBututs; RANGE requires min<=max; OPEN_TO_QUOTES forbids amounts.

QuoteWrite.description: Matching eligible WORKER only. One quote ever per worker/job. Integer bututs; expiry <=job expiry and <=14d, default min(3d,job expiry). Schedule is a preference, not a reservation.

QuoteUpdate.description: Unexpired PENDING owner quote only, while job remains OPEN/relevant. No owner/customer/status changes.

approximateDistanceKm.description: Distance rounded up to a five-km band; never precise metres

WorkerCard.description: Safe public marketplace card, excluding coordinates, contacts, account/security fields, verification media and notes.

AcceptedAgreement.description: Immutable commercial snapshot for Phase 4. No Booking/reservation; exact location remains private on the job.

coordinates.description: Exactly [longitude, latitude]. Longitude -180..180; latitude -90..90, checked server-side.

agreement.description: Immutable commercial snapshot for Phase 4. No Booking/reservation; exact location remains private on the job.

OwnJobRequest.description: Owning CUSTOMER only; contains private fulfillment location/address. EXPIRED can be derived without a stored-status mutation.

JobOpportunity.description: Eligible matching WORKER view. No customer identity/contacts, precise location/address, agreement or provider URLs. Attachment IDs require separately authorized access.

approximateDistanceKm.description: Distance rounded up to a five-km band; never precise metres

workerProfile.description: Safe public marketplace card, excluding coordinates, contacts, account/security fields, verification media and notes.

ReceivedQuote.description: Customer-job-owner-only comparison view. Worker card is null if no longer public/eligible; no competing-worker access.

budget.description: Optional customer budget guide. Positive safe integer bututs, maximum >= minimum. Never the agreed price.

listedAmountBututs.description: Required with LISTED_PRICE; server verifies the current FIXED listing exactly matches.

DirectProposalWrite.description: Use REQUEST_QUOTE without agreedAmountBututs, optionally budget/photos; or LISTED_PRICE with listedAmountBututs. Legacy clients without pricingMode must supply agreedAmountBututs. Requests do not hold a schedule.

Booking.description: Participant/admin view. Exact location/address are returned to the customer; the worker receives them only after payment confirmation. Expired unpaid reservations read as CANCELLED.

customerSummary.description: Participant-only customer name on proposal list/detail responses. Contact details and private location are excluded.

budget.description: Optional customer budget guide. Positive safe integer bututs, maximum >= minimum. Never the agreed price.

DirectProposal.description: Only the proposing customer receives precise location/address. Acceptance creates an unpaid Booking through the centralized engine.

simulatedTransactionVolumeBututs.description: Integer bututs represented as a string to preserve aggregate precision

simulatedPlatformRevenueBututs.description: Integer bututs represented as a string to preserve aggregate precision

simulatedRefundsBututs.description: Integer bututs represented as a string to preserve aggregate precision

expiresAt.description: Future time no later than the request deadline. Defaults to request deadline.

post.description: Authenticated multipart upload: exactly one file, max 5 MiB. Original profile/portfolio/verification purposes and COMPLETION_EVIDENCE are WORKER-only. JOB_ATTACHMENT is CUSTOMER-only. CHAT_IMAGE, VOICE_NOTE and DISPUTE_EVIDENCE allow CUSTOMER/WORKER. Images: decoded/re-encoded JPEG/PNG with metadata removed. Verification: PDF allowed. VOICE_NOTE: validated PCM WAV or Opus Ogg/WebM. All stored authenticated; purpose-specific relationship endpoints grant other participants short-lived access. No speech recognition.
